'''Krovas''' was one of [[Jorkatt]] the Render's chief [[Lieutenant/Legends|lieutenants]]. His [[Death/Legends|death]] was officially a swimming accident, although exactly why he went swimming with [[plasticrete]] bricks in his pockets was never determined.
